note: Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, verified against Exophase and PSNProfiles on 20 Nov 2026. Guides are this guide's own words; each cites its sources. PSN counts are the progress targets PSNProfiles lists.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing is online and no DLC is needed — one playthrough plus cleanup is enough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 and it pops as Chapter 2 opens.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4; it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the final mission — the same Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, that ends the story. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run — just play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress you make during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — roughly 60% of true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you only need 70 of the 80 challenges. The only things that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The hardest trophy in the set.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. They come in four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely; flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count in Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and find them on the map with the Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon). You will do most of them naturally while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The gold medals here are not too hard; work through each range's challenges and use the range's own scoring feedback to tighten your runs.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total across them. You need all of them for the 100% checklist too, so this comes along for the ride.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones you like; each location only counts once.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento — a purple icon on the map. Go there and beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one of them once is enough — you do not need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline — five quests, all Lucia-only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline — five quests. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain strangers count — confirmed ones are Kirk (the Skunk Ape strand), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile deliveries). Other questlines such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Strangers stay available after the story; track your count in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner; he then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to deliver to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, and deliver them in good condition for more money. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — Jason only. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers show synthetic labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest and Tyrone gives you Spin On This, which pops the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double, and you cannot reach the last spot until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one meditation only exists in Chapter 1, at Jason's house — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to meditate. It is not yet confirmed whether that one is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Do that quest and he marks hunting spots on the map; bring the animals he asks for back to him. The first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 set locations in total; finish any three sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan things in the world by holding up on the D-pad and R1 — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, and there are well over 100 to find, so scan anything that glows.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there — pick the easiest ones and leave the hardest 10 alone. Track them under Progress > Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner with right on the D-pad plus triangle. Build 4 stars, then escape: a fast sports motorcycle through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a good escape route since cops struggle to follow on the tracks. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Needs both characters (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). Hit three robbery targets in a row while the flashing wanted level stays up — wear body armor, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and keep moving. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's jewelry jobs (Chapter 3) unlock them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold up on the D-pad) and scan vehicles as they pass — you only need to scan them, not drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so stand on a busy road and keep scanning. Check totals in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds. Boost your focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home, or Adrenaline to extend it), line up five enemies — gang members at gang operations work — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up as you play (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots), so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away. It has to be a plane connected to a boarding bridge — the ones on the open airfield do not count. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport for it to pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before leaving. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it marks itself from story progress and walks you through the first one: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip for security van locations (finish his earlier Payday Loans quests first). Each vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then swap vehicles. There are 8 large bank jobs total and the 100% checklist needs all of them; one vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… covers this automatically — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts. Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map across all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them; track each gang's count in Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and smash straight out through the window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only that blue Banshee counts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police — and if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Needs character switching (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Work out together — call your partner and train at a fitness club (filter Activities on the map), and while one character works out the other trains too, so progress doubles. You can also work out at home after the story. Check strength in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and you will see a small demon face whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills all count, and it builds up passively while you chase everything else. If you are short at the end, it can be farmed quickly — though a high-violence profile makes cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Return to the Payday Loans store Lucia robbed in the prologue and rob the same store again as Lucia — alone, on foot. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Then go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, aim at the teller, deal with security, empty the three cash drawers, and run away on foot until the trophy pops — driving away does not count.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. On the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM and alone, you may find a blinking car at the roadside — the spawn is random, so drive away and come back if it is not there. Follow the path into the woods to the UFO's bright blue light, approach it, and it drops an abducted woman: talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl over 10 pedestrians with a melee drive-by — ride any bike and kick pedestrians with Square, 10 of them within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check first — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and deliver the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The total counts across all robberies, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money, since they are the most expensive. It adds up on its own while you gear up for everything else.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. They cost $160,000 in total and are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which appears after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to earn the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) since each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register — at first he only takes vehicles without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.
